name: Windows utilities · Info+ GUI companion
description: Graphical companion to the Info+ CLI: paired Windows desktop workflows with a narrow, reviewable surface inside a shared automation monorepo.
longDescription: A lightweight GUI companion that sits alongside the Info+ CLI in the same monorepo. It targets Windows desktop operators who need visual workflows while sharing logic and dependencies with the CLI entry point. Scope stays intentionally small for dependency review before wider distribution.
features: Paired CLI and GUI architecture for shared maintenance
Focused graphical workflows without feature creep
Co-located packaging patterns with the CLI utility
Dependency review guidance before external distribution
highlights: Demonstrates paired CLI and GUI packaging in one workspace
Small surface area suitable for internal tooling
challenges: Limited public documentation for this slice of the monorepo.
solutions: Keep the portfolio summary aligned with the actual code scope; source link provides full context.
security: Review GUI dependencies for supply-chain risk
Sign binaries when leaving trusted networks
Avoid world-writable paths for user data
